summary: Iteration 111 backend + frontend verification. 17/17 pytest cases passed covering (a) News multi-image + 7 layout templates + ?q= search, (b) Governor Manager cannot auto-approve hours (posts pending, 403 on /review approve and /hours/{id} approve, can still reject; Full admin still auto-approves with trendsetters_spirits regression covered), (c) /api/awards/eligibility Full admin returns all 7 keys, Governor + Membership Manager get 403, out-of-range year returns 400. Frontend: news empty-state renders 'No articles match', news editor shows 7 template options and 'Add photos (0/5)' button, Awards admin panel renders all 7 eligibility cards for Full admin, Awards tab hidden entirely from Governor (as designed).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: The news search input and the admin 'New article' trigger button lack explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. news-search, news-new-btn, admin-tab-news). Tests fall back to placeholder/text selectors. Not required by the current review spec, but adding them would harden future e2e tests.

The Service Ribbon streak_start_year() only reads status_history for status='active' — if a member is currently marked inactive_override, they are dropped, which matches the spec but means a member reactivated then re-inactivated within the same year is silently ignored. Consider documenting this edge case.

Chapter of the Year denominator is max(1, member_count - recruits). If all current members are counted (including those onboarded via non-recruitment paths, e.g. bulk-imported), the 'base_members' may under-count when recruits > member_count for the year (small chapters). No crash, but the score can spike unrealistically.
